rules.initialization: No SQL/schema/dependency/runtime change. Existing order lock, source read, copied attachment/mapping and audit transaction retained. COMMIT attempt marked before call, confirmed only after response. Only pre-COMMIT confirmed rollback cleans this newly created object. Unknown transaction connection is destroyed once; known committed DTO conversion occurs after release outside compensation. Cleanup failure emits a bounded secret-free warning and preserves original error. Unknown outcomes may retain unreferenced bytes, not delete possibly committed references.
rules.dateAndPermission: Existing published budget/version/source and current own-merchandiser/Root/PMC policy remains. No native event/time/quantity/price/dirty-registration changes. Unit source guard is explicitly mocked for control flow only; native PG cases exercise actual current-role policy and separate tuple/actor sources.
rules.expectation: Native isolated PostgreSQL executes real COMMIT before controlled client throws acknowledgement, then confirms one mapping, intact private bytes and one audit after retry. Native audit-then-fail rolls back image/mapping/event atomically and cleans only new bytes. Unit covers successful rollback after attempted COMMIT, failed rollback, post-COMMIT DTO failure and cleanup failure. Native same-tuple concurrent retries create one copy; different source/actor identities remain distinct. Partial two-image preparation does not undo first committed image and full retry reuses it.

rules.rule: Mapped-copy retry checks ready ownership/binding and verifies private bytes only after DB transaction and connection release.

rules.initialization: Existing mapping remains keyed by order,budgetVersion,sourceAttachment,actor. Reused attachment must be ready and owned, unbound or demonstrably attached to the same mother via original child relation. Original readBudgetSourcing already rejects a mother linked to sourcing: this entry guard is retained, not expanded by the helper binding check. HEAD validates size/MIME/available SHA. Missing SHA uses bounded readBytes and local digest, never ETag/unbounded computeSha256. One local five-second AbortSignal budget covers HEAD and hash fallback; no retry, global timeout or repair.
rules.dateAndPermission: No cross-user cache, public grant, original image replacement, authorization expansion or thumbnail changes. Missing object409, corrupt metadata/content422 and storage transport/OSS denied503 are distinct, existing ApplicationError preserved. No false full preparation success on partial batch. Current authority is checked before mapping lookup as before.
rules.expectation: Actual storage tests verify HEAD starts after COMMIT/release, no new copy on retry, missing/403/size/MIME/SHA errors, absent-metadata hash success/corruption, HEAD deadline and remaining hash budget after slow HEAD. Native tests retain original image bytes, new/historical private thumbnails, inherited/published bindings and last authorization of the same real signed session revoked during generation. Existing unrelated thumbnail generation remains bounded and unchanged.

rules.initialization: Shared budget fixture keeps its existing explicit referenced-domain schema, now uses original createOwnedPostgresSchema/releaseOwnedPostgresSchema instead of legacy manual CREATE/DROP. Native preview fixture independently uses current complete schema and original real AuthService. No trigger disabling added. Existing changed-PG canonical discovery maps the touched suite, unit is picked by original non-DB runner; no CI/risk-map edit or ops drill. Local command safety required NODE_ENV=test and correctly rejected first missing setting; runner corrected, guard retained. First unit attempt used Buffer vs Uint8Array structural equality; fixed to byte equality. Preflight found old manual schema creator when fixture became modified; migrated to original resource contract and reran affected native checks. Failed attempts remain private and are not counted as passes.
rules.dateAndPermission: No time, SLA or production data changes. Fixture confirms current role revocation using unchanged trusted-actor service boundary; only existing preview suite is cited for real signed AuthService last-check behavior, not new budget command tests. Local Node22.22.2/npm10.9.9/PG16.15 CPUs/resource boundaries recorded per check, not asserted equivalent to CI hardware or onsite.
rules.expectation: Current exact-source87 unit/routes and12 PostgreSQL cases pass, zero skips; API types, scoped lint, original preflight and secret scan pass. No unrelated5000-order/browser rerun. These are local checks; remote light/Review/final Full and actual merge are separate pending stages.
